name: The Omens
text: The ground trembles. Livestock will not settle, and the old maps no longer agree with the coast.

uniques: Triggers the following global alert: [Something is stirring. We have perhaps twenty years to ready ourselves]

name: The Awakening
text: Something vast has stirred beneath the earth...

uniques: Triggers the following global alert: [The Awakening has begun]

name: Stage II Awakening
text: An army is gathering beneath the earth...

uniques: Gain a free [Crisis Stage II Beacon] [in capital]
Triggers the following global alert: [The Awakening grows stronger, the world mobilises in defense]

name: Stage III Awakening
text: An army breaks from the earth...

uniques: Gain a free [Crisis Stage III Beacon] [in capital]
Triggers the following global alert: [The Awakening is here, the world is on the edge of destruction]

name: The Crisis Passes
text: The enemies stop coming, they have been repelled and the world breathes a sigh of relief...
